title: Care Centre Training Notes: FilterDirect Billing and the Subscription Balance
content:
**Billing rule for FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions.** Shipments are charged to the card on file on the ship date and paid by the same card the same day. Sales tax is charged at the delivery county rate. A balance left by a failed charge is collected by the automatic retries of that failed charge, and no new shipment leaves while a balance is owing.

**The subscription balance.** Each subscription carries a balance in US dollars: the amount the subscriber owes. Charges raise it; payments and credits lower it.

| Raises the balance | Lowers the balance |
|---|---|
| Shipment charge | Card payment |
| Shipping fee | Damaged-shipment credit |
| Size-change fee | Wrong-size credit |
| | Member filter discount |

### Questions and answers

**When does the card get charged for a shipment?** On the ship date, and the same card pays it the same day.

**At what rate is sales tax charged?** At the rate of the county the shipment is delivered to.

**A charge failed and the balance is still owing. How is it collected?** By the automatic retries of the failed charge.

**Can the next shipment leave while that balance is owing?** No. No new shipment leaves while a balance is owing.

### Illustration (hypothetical amounts, sales tax not shown)

| Entry on the ship date | Amount | Balance after |
|---|---|---|
| Opening balance | | $0.00 |
| Shipment charge | $30.00 | $30.00 |
| Shipping fee | $5.99 | $35.99 |
| Card payment, same day | $35.99 | $0.00 |

Had the card payment not gone through, the balance would have stood at $35.99, and no new shipment would leave while it was owing.
